title: Bug 1971060 - Convert virtual folder search terms to SQL queries. r=BenC I've rearranged the filters to precalculate the SQL parameters they use, at the same time as the SQL 'WHERE' clause, since they either won't change, or will both change at the same time. This also allows us to inspect the clause and parameters in tests, which is very helpful in finding edge cases.
